name: Internal Core Fist Rotation
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Make tight fists with the thumbs tucked inside the fingers, then rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension. The wrist is the dial: a small, deliberate internal rotation pulls a stretch up the whole back chain — forearm to elbow to shoulder to lats to low back to pelvis. The finger position fires the deep forearm muscles that connect through to the fingertip tendons. Move slowly, breathe steadily, and feel the line lengthen rather than chasing a big range. ~30-60s.
